snippet.title: "Heroic Tale VALUE!" (2020) ※First Minutes Gameplay※
snippet.description:
"While the King Arthur’s health continues to deteriorate due to an unfathomable disease, his
advisors desperately seek the help of the wise ascetics. Lost somewhere in the recesses of Albhain is the Chalice of Life, which they claim could negate any affliction. This is the time,
as the elected disciple, to devote all your strength to protect the kingdom!”

"Heroic Tale VALUE!" is available at
[ KA·IN WORKS - A Fantasy Simulation Project ]
https://fantasysimulation.com/heroictalevalue

[ Itch.Io ]
https://kainworks.itch.io/heroic-tale-value
